issue_context.title: Missing image tag event on build
issue_context.body:
### Description

Building an image doesn't emit any "image tag" events

### Reproduce

In one terminal run `docker events` and in another run

```console
$ cat << EOF | docker build -f- -t test /var/empty
FROM scratch
EOF
```

### Expected behavior

We shoud see an `image tag` event in the first terminal:

```
2023-12-06T14:35:37.810440001+01:00 image tag sha256:54ac6bb475f018dd78804ac491a2dc0e0e3331f8b6347e56b75c61fffee81011 (name=test)
```

### docker version

```bash
master
```


### docker info

```bash
master
```


### Additional Info

_No response_

review_comments:
I'm wondering if we're trying too hard here; my thinking is that `ExporterInstance.Export` would probably fail if any of the `OptKeyName` values was invalid. If it didn't fail then we _should _ assume that all of them were accepted.

From that perspective, we could just split the string, and call `i.callbacks.Named(ctx, namedTagged, desc)`

Yeah it's unexpected that the parsing will fail at this point (as highlighted in comment). The intent here was to provide a `reference.Named` type instead of raw string to match what the value actually represents.
